title: Netherlands: coverage gap
description: Coverage-gap pass 2026-10-06: Dutch bouldering and climbing halls outside Amsterdam, Den Haag, Utrecht and Rotterdam (Eindhoven, Groningen, Nijmegen, Arnhem, Tilburg, Breda, Zwolle, Enschede, Leiden, Haarlem, Amersfoort, Maastricht, Delft and others), plus chain branches.
